content.short: Crypto launchpad designed for projects, controlled by you. Interact with high-potential projects and invest in them.
content.description:
Our core service is developing technology that opens up new investment opportunities and makes DeFi accessible for everyone. With simplicity at the core of our priorities, we aim to make the user journey as easy and enjoyable as possible by improving every component involved, starting from design, customer support, wallet and API integrations, all the way to a one-time frictionless KYC. We are not transaction-based like other launchpads, we are community-based. We recognize the power that a community holds. That is why we give them complete control. They hold the power to make a project a reality.

A simple and secure way to get access to early-stage Cardano-Polygon projects. Research about new projects, perform a one-time KYC, invest in new projects and track of your investments. All the tools you need to be part of the next big thing in crypto.

Empower projects you believe in by upvoting, commenting, and participating in forums. Invest in community-upvoted projects that meet the Vent quality standards. The power is in your hands.

Stake $VENT tokens to earn points that you can use to buy into future token sales. Being engaged in the community and holding $VENT tokens will earn you weekly rewards. Open doors to new possibilities.
